about_the_game:
"Milo's Tiny Fish Pond" is a relaxing and enjoyable healing game that allows you to enjoy the pleasure of raising fish in your spare time while working!

Core gameplay:

Easy to place, free to grow Place the game window in a corner of the desktop, and you can earn "rice grains" currency by hanging up. Use rice grains to buy mysterious fish packs, hatch random fish - from lively clownfish to luxurious dragonfish, each with a unique juvenile and adult form.

Immersive interactive experience

Right-click on the fish tank to put fish food, observe the young fish swimming towards the food; adult fish can be sold for more rice grains, forming a sustainable breeding cycle.

Infinite creative space

Unlock multiple fish tanks with different styles, freely adjust the layout, and match decorations to create an exclusive underwater paradise. With no quantity limit, how many surprises can your desktop hold?

Zero-pressure relaxation philosophy

No complex operations, no penalty for failure. Whether you are focusing on work or taking a short break, the swimming fish and the sound of water will bring you peace.

Suitable for you:

► Casual players who love collecting and raising

► Decorators who pursue desktop beauty

► Office workers/students who need to relieve pressure

Release time: Q2 2025

**Join the wish list now and bring your desktop to life!**
